prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Input images: Image 1 is a structural reference for Conductor's nested project/workspace rail, mature pane density, and compact desktop proportions only; do not copy its colors, exact components, text, or branding.
Primary request: Design Browser-First Sylph. Keep the proven Conductor-like IDE shell, but make the running product rather than the agent transcript the center of gravity.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed desktop app at the reference image's wide aspect, no device frame, no marketing page.
Structure: Far-left global utility strip. Next, a persistent 300px navigation rail groups each Repository as a parent row and nests compact Workspaces directly below it with branch icon, status dot, and concise +/− change summary. Never create separate Repository and Workspace sections. Center: live browser preview dominates about 52% of the usable width with real URL chrome, desktop/mobile breakpoint control, inspect, reload, take-control state. Right: agent thread and composer occupy about 28%. Bottom evidence deck spans below browser and agent with Changes, Checks, Console, Skills tabs. Top breadcrumb names repository then active Workspace.
Content: Repositories `folkhero-web`, `stett`, `open-relic`; nested Workspaces under folkhero-web: `Checkout restoration` +148 −22, `Fix OAuth callback` +31, `Upgrade billing webhook` +82 −9. Active Workspace Checkout restoration. Agent task Polish the onboarding flow. Browser shows a tasteful FolkHero onboarding screen. Status Browser checks 4/4, Live, Agent controlling browser. Files src/routes/onboarding.tsx and src/styles/onboarding.css.
Style/medium: Distinctive contemporary developer application, not a physical metaphor. Matte near-black graphite, crisp pale text, saturated electric cobalt as the large active-Workspace edge and browser focus field, acid-lime only for verified/live status. Stronger typographic hierarchy than Conductor: compact grotesk UI with distinctive wide numerals, generous transcript line height, exact code face. Square and softly clipped 4px corners, no rounded-card dashboard.
Composition/framing: Preserve the reference's nested hierarchy and quiet density. Make the browser unmistakably primary. The active Workspace gains a 3px cobalt left edge plus a shallow cobalt field, not just a dot. The repository group remains visually stable while children scroll.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Repositories`, `folkhero-web`, `stett`, `open-relic`, `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Live`, `Agent controlling browser`, `Changes`, `Checks`, `Console`, `Skills`.
Constraints: Familiar enough to sit beside Conductor, bb, and Diffs; visibly Sylph at a glance. Persistent nested Repository → Workspace rail on the left. Browser preview first-class. Dense, keyboard-first, accessible contrast. No fabricated claims.
Avoid: copying Conductor's brown-black palette, generic VS Code clone, separate repo/workspace navigation buckets, bento cards, physical metaphor, gradients, glassmorphism, neon glow, excessive pills, marketing hero, device frame, illegible tiny text.
